title: pedicularis racemosa var. alba
intro: Pedicularis racemosa var. alba, commonly known as White Lousewort, is a perennial flowering plant native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall immune function. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis racemosa var. alba include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and a diuretic, helping to relieve muscle spasms and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as aucubin and albine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
